class.name: OpenXRAndroidViewportFeatheringExtension
class.brief_description: Allow getting the viewport feathering insets via [code]XR_ANDROID_viewport_feathering[/code].
class.description: Allow getting the viewport feathering insets via [code]XR_ANDROID_viewport_feathering[/code].

method.name: get_display_safe_area
method.description: Returns a [code]Rect2i[/code] representing the safe area to put UI elements, such that they won't overlap any viewport feathering. If the [code]XR_ANDROID_viewport_feathering[/code] extension isn't enabled or supported, this will return a [code]Rect2i[/code] with a size of [code]Vector2i(0, 0)[/code].

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this extension is supported on this device; otherwise, [code]false[/code].
